title: vitis quadrangularis
intro: Vitis quadrangularis, commonly known as the climbing grape vine or the five-angled vine, is a plant species native to tropical Asia. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is known to provide several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral activities. The bioactive constituents of Vitis quadrangularis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Vitis quadrangularis include analgesic, anti-diarrheal, and anti-cancer effects, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
